title: Machine Learning Instrument Variables for Causal Inference
authors: Amandeep Singh; Kartik Hosanagar; Amit Gandhi
eligible_reason: Methodological paper on machine-learning instrumental variables; simulations (Tables 4-7), a Nielsen Ad Intel application regressing log GRP on continuous political GRP or the ML instrument with market and month FE (Table 8), and BLP demand on Nevo cereal data (Table 9). No binary staggered treatment.
design_notes: run-Regression.R: felm(log(1+GRP) ~ PGRP | MarketCode + month | 0 | MarketCode) first-stage strength checks; the regressor is continuous.
data_files_note: Tables 4-7 are simulated in code; Table 8 needs Nielsen Ad Intel (Kilts, not shipped); Table 9 uses the Nevo data bundled with pyblp.
data_provenance_note: Empirical Nielsen application data not shipped.
software_notes: Python notebooks (linearmodels, pyblp, torch) and one R script (lfe).
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); screened from README, regression inventory, main-results code and OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
